title: Can I BEAT Stockfish by Castling?
summary: Chess where castling (either side) instantly wins for the player, vs Fairy-Stockfish. Game 1 as White: Tony develops kingside and castles to win immediately. Game 2: Fairy-Stockfish gets White/first move and Tony as Black still castles. Game 3: he gives the engine extra advantages; it sacrifices a bishop to strip castling rights, but he castles queenside and wins all games.
rules: Normal chess, but if the player castles (kingside or queenside) the player wins immediately.
Normal castling legality applies (can't castle through/out of check, rights lost if king/rook moved).
Bot (Fairy-Stockfish) plays normally and tries to destroy castling rights; normal checkmate also ends the game.

opponent.name: Fairy-Stockfish
opponent.avatar_description: Stockfish fish icon; thumbnail is white rook + white king icons '= win'

current_impl_issues: Impl specialmate k=castle says 'only a castling checkmate counts; any other mate is a draw' — wrong. Rule is: castling itself wins instantly.
